name: Example Pack
author: SBLoveFramework
_comment: A worked example of the addon format. Copy this, change the ids, and
point the paths at animations your own pak ships.
beside the .pak/.utoc/.ucas carrying the animation assets themselves.
The animations used below are Eve's own stock locomotion set, so this
pack runs with no extra assets installed. It is a demonstration of the
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored by the loader.

scenes._actors: Who plays each role. A is the anchor and stays put; B is placed relative to A. Names come from the character table, see docs/character-map.md.

_alignment: Where B stands relative to A, in centimetres, in A's OWN frame:
yaw      B's facing relative to A. 180 = facing each other.
These belong to the animation. Two clips authored separately will
never line up from a formula, so whoever made them records the
offset that fits. Ignored when a scene has no B actor.
_loops: The intensity axis, gentlest first. The player moves along it
rather than picking from it, and secondary motion follows the
Each entry gives the animation for each actor. They start
together, so a pair authored as a pair stays in sync.

scenes._note: A paired scene needs actors.B, and every loop that names a B animation needs one. Two actors of the SAME character are refused, because they would share one BlendSpace asset and one would overwrite the other.
